text: Hello! I'm Gronny. Welcome to our sustainable garden. Our goal is to grow a tomato while saving water, so our water reserve is limited. Come over to the table, and let's begin.
Welcome to the practice garden. Learn to move, plant, water, refill your can and use the calendar here. Water refills freely during practice. Then we'll enter the sustainable garden.
Your watering can is empty. Open the calendar and select Refill water.
